CCTV Installation Cost in Delhi NCR: Complete 2026 Pricing Guide

If you're planning to install a CCTV system in your Noida home, Greater Noida office, or anywhere across Delhi NCR, understanding the actual costs upfront saves you from surprise expenses and helps you budget correctly.

This guide breaks down every component of CCTV installation costs based on 2026 market prices and our experience installing systems in 3000+ properties across Delhi NCR.

HD Analog CCTV Installation Costs

Analog systems remain popular for budget-conscious customers. Here's what you can expect:

2-Camera HD Analog Setup

  • Cameras (2x 2MP): ₹3,500 - ₹5,000
  • 4-Channel DVR: ₹4,500 - ₹6,500
  • Cables & Wiring: ₹1,500 - ₹2,500
  • Installation Labor: ₹2,000 - ₹3,000
  • HDD (1TB): ₹2,500 - ₹3,500
  • Total: ₹14,000 - ₹20,000

4-Camera HD Analog Setup

  • Cameras (4x 2MP): ₹6,500 - ₹9,000
  • 8-Channel DVR: ₹6,500 - ₹8,500
  • Cables & Wiring: ₹2,500 - ₹4,000
  • Installation Labor: ₹3,000 - ₹4,500
  • HDD (2TB): ₹4,000 - ₹5,500
  • Total: ₹23,000 - ₹31,000

8-Camera HD Analog Setup

  • Cameras (8x 2MP): ₹12,000 - ₹16,000
  • 8-Channel DVR + Expansion: ₹8,000 - ₹11,000
  • Cables & Wiring: ₹4,000 - ₹6,000
  • Installation Labor: ₹5,000 - ₹7,000
  • HDD (2-4TB): ₹6,000 - ₹10,000
  • Total: ₹35,000 - ₹50,000

IP CCTV System Installation Costs

IP systems offer better image quality and remote access. Prices are higher but include advanced features:

2-Camera 4K IP Setup

  • Cameras (2x 4MP): ₹6,000 - ₹8,000
  • 4-Channel PoE NVR: ₹8,000 - ₹12,000
  • Network Switch & Cabling: ₹3,000 - ₹5,000
  • Installation Labor: ₹3,000 - ₹4,500
  • HDD (2TB): ₹4,000 - ₹5,500
  • Total: ₹24,000 - ₹35,000

4-Camera 4K IP Setup

  • Cameras (4x 4MP): ₹11,000 - ₹15,000
  • 8-Channel PoE NVR: ₹10,000 - ₹15,000
  • Network Infrastructure: ₹4,000 - ₹7,000
  • Installation Labor: ₹4,000 - ₹6,000
  • HDD (2-4TB): ₹6,000 - ₹10,000
  • Total: ₹35,000 - ₹53,000

8-Camera 4K IP Setup

  • Cameras (8x 4MP): ₹22,000 - ₹30,000
  • 16-Channel PoE NVR + Switch: ₹15,000 - ₹25,000
  • Network Infrastructure: ₹6,000 - ₹10,000
  • Installation Labor: ₹6,000 - ₹9,000
  • HDD (4-8TB): ₹10,000 - ₹18,000
  • Total: ₹59,000 - ₹92,000

Premium & Hybrid System Costs

Biometric + CCTV Integration

  • Basic CCTV + Biometric Lock: ₹30,000 - ₹50,000
  • Complete System (4 cameras + biometric + access control): ₹50,000 - ₹85,000

Cloud Storage & Remote Monitoring

  • Cloud subscription (1 camera, 30-day retention): ₹500 - ₹1,200/month
  • Cloud subscription (8 cameras, 90-day retention): ₹2,500 - ₹4,500/month
  • Mobile app integration (one-time): ₹5,000 - ₹10,000

Cost Breakdown by Property Type

Residential Apartment (2-3 BHK)

  • Average 2-4 camera setup: ₹18,000 - ₹45,000
  • Typical Timeline: 1-2 days installation
  • Recommended: IP system with cloud backup for peace of mind

Independent House

  • Average 4-8 camera setup: ₹40,000 - ₹90,000
  • Typical Timeline: 2-3 days installation
  • Recommended: Hybrid system with perimeter + interior coverage

Small Office/Retail Shop

  • Average 4-6 camera setup: ₹35,000 - ₹65,000
  • Typical Timeline: 1-2 days (usually after business hours)
  • Recommended: IP system with remote monitoring and recording

Large Office/Factory

  • Average 12-20 camera setup: ₹120,000 - ₹250,000+
  • Typical Timeline: 3-7 days installation
  • Recommended: Enterprise IP system with AI analytics, facial recognition

Money-Saving Tips

1. Plan Before Installing

Proper site survey saves on wiring costs. Many customers end up paying extra because cable routing wasn't planned. Eye Smart offers free site surveys in Noida, Ghaziabad, and across Delhi NCR.

2. Choose Hybrid Systems

Mix HD analog for perimeter coverage with IP cameras for entry points. This saves 20-30% compared to full IP while keeping critical areas high-res.

3. Upgrade Gradually

Start with 2-4 cameras and expand later as budget allows. Our modular approach means zero reinstallation costs when adding cameras.

4. Negotiate Bundled Rates

Get better pricing when combining CCTV with biometric access control or alarm systems. Our bundled packages save up to 15%.

Factors Affecting Installation Cost

Distance & Cabling

Long cable runs (50+ meters) increase costs due to additional materials and labor. Budget ₹50-100 per meter for quality cabling.

Existing Infrastructure

Buildings with existing conduits/cable trays reduce installation costs. New construction requires more extensive wiring.

Camera Placement Height

High-ceiling installations (factory, warehouse) cost more due to equipment needed and safety precautions.

Backup Power Requirements

Adding UPS/battery backup for 24x7 recording adds ₹5,000-15,000 depending on system size.

Warranty & Maintenance Costs

  • Standard Warranty: 1 year on equipment, 6 months on labor (included)
  • Extended Warranty: ₹3,000-5,000/year
  • AMC (Annual Maintenance): ₹2,500-8,000/year depending on system size
  • Hard Disk Replacement: ₹2,500-5,500 (usually needed every 3-4 years)

Comparison: What Other Vendors Charge

We've researched typical pricing in Noida and Delhi NCR markets:

  • Budget Installers: 10-15% cheaper but low-quality components
  • Premium Brands: 20-30% more expensive, often including unnecessary features
  • Eye Smart: Best price-to-quality ratio with proven 24/7 support

Conclusion

CCTV installation costs in Delhi NCR vary widely based on system type, number of cameras, and property complexity. For most homes and offices, a 4-camera hybrid system between ₹30,000-50,000 provides excellent protection and value.
